author: Liqe
body:
Dear LegendaryEngram,


OK you've won the fight but please take upon my word that I will never use hacks ever again. Please unban me. If I ever use hacks again you will notice it on the console anyway and you can ban me. Failing that please can you reduce my punishment to a temp-ban because without this server I will be seriously bored. Would you really want to end a fellow gamers fun?

If it was you being banned how would you feel?

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
Hello,

I will not reduce your punishment. You must face the consequences of your actions.

Try appeal in a couple of months. Time heals these wounds.

Regards,
LegendaryEngram, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
